title: Find Players With Zero Or One Losses
statement:
Each pair in `matches` is `[winner, loser]`, and no outcome pair is repeated. Return `[zeroLoss, oneLoss]`: the sorted list of players who have lost zero matches and the sorted list of players who have lost exactly one match. Include only players who appear in at least one match.

## Examples

```text
Input: matches = [[2, 3], [1, 3], [5, 4], [6, 4]]
Output: [[1, 2, 5, 6], []]
```

```text
Input: matches = [[1, 2], [2, 3], [4, 3]]
Output: [[1, 4], [2]]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= matches.length <= 10^5`
- Each match has two distinct players in `[1, 10^5]`.
- No two matches are identical.
